system.description: Characteristics Basic Skills Advanced Skills: Piety (acquired and trained 1 {De}) Skill - Strength Athletics {De} Skill Specialisations: Bonus {Df} die: Resist Fear (Discipline), Omens and portents (Piety) Ballistic Skill Talent Cards: Determined (Focus), Insanity (choose one from deck) (Insanity) Special Action Cards: Disorienting Strike, Judgement of Vengeance, Berserker Rage!, Drunken Strike (black fire pass) Special Race Ability: Monster Slayer: Ostermarkers gain 1 {Df} die to all Attacks that target the defence of any creature with a Fear or Terror rating. Stoic Defenders: Add 1 {Dm} die to all attacks that target the defence of an Ostermarker whenever he is outnumbered. Corruption Threshold: 5 + Toughness (Resilience check) - Current corruption points: 5 Armour: Sigmarite-detailed Leather Armour: Defence 0, Soak 2 Intelligence Charm Weapons: Flail DR7/CR3, Slow, Vicious, 2-handed {De} Heavy Spiked Incense Burner (morningstar) DR6/CR3, Slow, Special Discipline (Special Morningstar Note: Opponents using Block or Parry against a morning star place an additional recharge token on the Active Defense card(s) used). (Vicious flail: these weapons leave particularly grisly wounds. For each critical wound inflicted, draw two cards and select the one with the higher severity). (Slow flail and morningstar: These weapons are generally bulky and unwieldy. When an attack action with a slow weapon hits, place one additional recharge token on the action card). Intuition Other Equipment: Travelling clothes, rucksack, preaching clothes, knick-knacks, angst-ridden prayer/atonement vows attached to clothes, incense, filthy double-tailed-comet Fellowship Sigmar holy symbol, (3) flasks of common spirits (if drink all at once, gain Intoxicated condition). Coins: 1 gold, 8 silver coins. Nature Lore Observation
